{{Quote|How, by the way, does ''anya-seff'' translate?"<br />"Dead brain.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Tila Mong]]|<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''''Ayna-seff''''' or '''Dead&ndash;brain''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] in the ''[[hassat-durr]]'' family taught by the [[Baran Do]] sages on [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. Like other techniques of the family, ''ayna-seff'' suffused the user's body with a low level of electromagnetic radiation. The radiation was produced as an interaction between the Force and ones own mental influence over their nervous system.<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

''Ayna&ndash;seff'' made the user's brain activity undetectable. It could also be used to disabled the user's own prosthetics or electronic implants. It could also interfere with shock shackles and could provide a range&ndash;boost for com&ndash;links. It was also capable of changing how animals senses percieved the user.<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

To learn it, a small, two-piece device was used: a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] sphere and a charged plate. Attuned to the precise intensities and frequencies of the technique's energy output, the goal was to raise the ball in the air and keep it steady.<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

It was recommended that a user perfect the technique entirely before using it in the field as the electromagnetic radiation produced by a student early in their training was a magnet for lightning. If not perfected the user would be struck by lightning repellent and killed.<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

In [[43 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was taught the technique by [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Mistress of the Order]] [[Tila Mong]]. When he and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] entered the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] searching for the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]], Luke would use the technique to protect the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' by repelling the electromagnetic radiation found throughout the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] found there. The technique had [[34 ABY/Legends|earlier]] been taught to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] by Master of the Order [[Koro Ziil]].<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] was also familiar with the technique. He explained that it could be used to fool an [[electroencephaloscan]]. [[Valin Horn]] would do this after gaining knowledge of the ability as a result of his [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]].<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />
